implementation_approach: TDD - write failing tests first, then verify they pass with existing implementation

tests.name: analyze_ready_empty_spec_test
tests.contract: Empty spec produces valid ReadyReport with scores in range [0, 100]
tests.assertion: All dimension scores and overall_readiness in [0, 100]

tests.name: analyze_ready_minimal_spec_test
tests.contract: Minimal spec with basic fields produces low but valid scores

tests.name: analyze_ready_complete_spec_test
tests.contract: Well-formed spec with all fields produces high scores
tests.setup: Spec with audience, success_criteria, behaviors, checks, etc

tests.name: analyze_ready_generates_blockers_test
tests.contract: Low dimension scores generate appropriate blockers
tests.setup: Spec with low scores in multiple dimensions
tests.assertion: blockers list not empty, contains Critical/High severity

tests.name: analyze_ready_generates_recommendations_test
tests.assertion: recommendations list not empty, sorted by priority

tests.name: analyze_replacement_via_analyze_ready_short_description_test
tests.contract: Short description (<=50 chars) reduces replacement score

tests.name: analyze_replacement_via_analyze_ready_no_version_dot_test
tests.contract: Version without dot reduces replacement score

tests.name: analyze_replacement_via_analyze_ready_complete_test
tests.contract: All replacement criteria met produces high score
tests.setup: Spec with audience, 3+ success_criteria, long description, semantic version, ai_hints

tests.name: analyze_empathy_via_analyze_ready_no_error_behaviors_test
tests.contract: No 4xx status behaviors produces low empathy score

tests.name: analyze_empathy_via_analyze_ready_has_validation_keywords_test
tests.contract: Validation keywords in intent/notes boost empathy

tests.name: analyze_actionable_via_analyze_ready_no_checks_test
tests.contract: No response checks produces actionable score of 0

tests.name: analyze_actionable_via_analyze_ready_has_checks_test
tests.contract: 3+ behaviors with checks produce high actionable score

tests.name: analyze_actionable_via_analyze_ready_quality_checks_test
tests.contract: Checks with detailed 'why' boost actionable score

tests.name: analyze_actionable_via_analyze_ready_clear_intents_test
tests.contract: Clear intents (>20 chars) boost actionable score

tests.name: analyze_discoverable_via_analyze_ready_multiple_features_test
tests.contract: 3+ features produce high feature score component

tests.name: analyze_discoverable_via_analyze_ready_has_tags_test
tests.contract: Behaviors with tags boost discoverable score
tests.assertion: discoverable.score includes tag bonus (up to 30 points)

tests.name: analyze_yet_complete_via_analyze_ready_incomplete_test
tests.contract: Missing features, rules, ai_hints, config produces low score

tests.name: analyze_yet_complete_via_analyze_ready_features_without_behaviors_test
tests.contract: Features without behaviors reduce yet_complete score
tests.assertion: yet_complete.score penalized, issues contains 'Features without behaviors'

tests.name: analyze_yet_complete_via_analyze_ready_complete_test
tests.contract: All completeness criteria met produces score of 100
tests.setup: Spec with features+behaviors, rules, ai_hints, config.base_url

tests.name: calculate_overall_readiness_weighted_average_test
tests.assertion: overall_readiness matches weighted formula within float tolerance

tests.name: calculate_overall_readiness_all_zero_test
tests.contract: All dimensions zero produces overall of 0

tests.name: generate_blockers_overall_below_70_test
tests.assertion: blockers contains Critical severity blocker for overall readiness

tests.name: generate_blockers_dimension_below_40_test
tests.assertion: blockers contains Critical blocker for Replacement

tests.name: generate_blockers_dimension_40_to_60_test
tests.assertion: blockers contains High blocker for Empathy

tests.name: generate_blockers_dimension_60_to_75_test
tests.assertion: blockers contains Medium blocker for Actionable

tests.name: generate_blockers_no_blockers_test
tests.setup: Spec with all dimensions >= 75 and overall >= 80

tests.name: format_report_includes_dimension_scores_test
tests.assertion: output contains score values for R, E, A, D, Y

tests.name: format_report_includes_blockers_test
tests.contract: Output contains blocker information when present

tests.name: format_report_readiness_labels_test
tests.contract: Output shows correct readiness label (Launch Ready, Beta, etc)

success_criteria: All tests pass with existing ready.gleam implementation
Test coverage includes all public functions
Tests verify all 5 dimension scoring logic
Tests verify blocker and recommendation generation
